sampleNote: Billie's socket history: v1 is the July 8 socket she was fitted with; v2 short and v2 long are the October 17 candidates built on the updated attachment surfaces.

iterations.label: v1
iterations.title: First printed socket
iterations.author: Give a Paw team
iterations.summary: The socket Billie was fitted with, generated in nTop on July 8 over the first attachment surface (BillieSocket_7_8.3mf). Her body here is the solid scan from the same session (Billie_solid_FUll.obj, billie-solid-full.glb), which the October 17 solid matches.

changes.text: First printed socket: lattice socket with the mechanical interface, reach to X −75 mm.

iterations.label: v2 short
iterations.title: Socket 10-17, short reach
iterations.author: Tyler
iterations.summary: October 17 socket built on the updated attachment surface (Billie_Updated_Surface_10-17). Same scan frame as the August 10 socket.

changes.text: Rebuilt on the updated attachment surface; reach shortened from X −75 mm (v1) to −42 mm.
changes.why: Candidate A of the October 17 pair; compare with the long reach side by side.

iterations.label: v2 long
iterations.title: Socket 10-17, long reach
iterations.author: Tyler
iterations.summary: October 17 socket built on the longer attachment surface (Billie_Surface_longer_10-17). Same scan frame as the short candidate.

changes.text: Rebuilt on the longer attachment surface; reach X −70 mm, close to v1 (−75 mm) and 28 mm beyond the short candidate.
changes.why: Candidate B of the October 17 pair; more body contact ahead of the attachment.
